sentences.en: I'm Gemma Spake, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through the biggest changes, moments, and transitions of our 20s,
sentences.zh: 我是杰玛·斯佩克，欢迎回到《20多岁的心理学》，在这个播客里，我们探讨20多岁时经历的最大变化、时刻和过渡，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here back for another amazing guest episode.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能回来收听另一期精彩的嘉宾访谈。

sentences.en: If I had to pick two categories that I think I get the most questions about when it comes to our 20s, it would no doubt be love and money.
sentences.zh: 如果我必须选出两个我在20多岁时被问到最多的类别，那毫无疑问是爱情和金钱。

sentences.en: And although we might view those as separate topics, separate ideas, they are actually deeply linked.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们可能将它们视为独立的话题或概念，但它们实际上是深度关联的。

sentences.en: How we think about money, it affects how we date, who we date, how our love stories turn out, and how we think about love will impact
sentences.zh: 我们对金钱的看法会影响我们的约会方式、约会对象以及爱情故事的走向，而我们对爱情的看法也会影响

sentences.en: what money problems, money issues, money value differences we may overlook.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会忽视哪些金钱问题、财务纠纷或金钱价值观差异。

sentences.en: So today, let's talk about the intersection of money, relationships, and psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，让我们来谈谈金钱、人际关系和心理学的交集。

sentences.en: Everything from prenups to how much you should spend on a wedding, if and when you should get joint bank accounts, and why you really need to understand your money story
sentences.zh: 从婚前协议到婚礼该花多少钱，是否以及何时应该开设联名银行账户，以及为什么你真的需要了解你的金钱故事，

sentences.en: to really show up in your relationship.
sentences.zh: 才能在人际关系中展现真实的自我。

sentences.en: Of course, I am not a financial expert, but I do have someone joining me today who is, and who is not only a financial expert, but an expert in love and money.
sentences.zh: 当然，我不是金融专家，但我今天请来了一位专家，他不仅是金融专家，还是爱情与金钱方面的专家。

sentences.zh: 我是杰克·霍华德。

sentences.en: I serve as head of money wellness for Ally Bank.
sentences.zh: 我担任Ally银行的财务健康主管。

sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的角色，我已经担任了大约两年了。

sentences.en: I've had the pleasure of working for Ally for 15 years in various roles, everything from our corporate giving, where I focused on financial education for underserved communities
sentences.zh: 我有幸在Ally工作了15年，担任过各种职务，从企业捐赠（我专注于为服务不足的社区提供金融教育），

sentences.en: and corporate giving and employee volunteerism.
sentences.zh: 到企业捐赠和员工志愿服务。

sentences.en: I did that for a big chunk of my time.
sentences.zh: 我职业生涯中很大一部分时间都在做这些。

sentences.en: And then I moved to our invest business where I did a stretch role as chief of staff for the president there and decided to stay and help launch our personal advice business,
sentences.zh: 后来我转到了投资业务部门，担任总裁的幕僚长，并决定留下来帮助启动我们的个人咨询业务，

sentences.en: where you work with a personal wealth advisor to help you to think through retirement.
sentences.zh: 在那里你与个人财富顾问合作，帮助你规划退休。

sentences.en: And it was during that piece of my career where I was introduced to money psychology.
sentences.zh: 正是在我职业生涯的那个阶段，我接触到了金钱心理学。

sentences.en: When you're better aligned to your values, your emotions, and really understand the behaviors that you have behind some of your money decisions,
sentences.zh: 当你更好地与自己的价值观、情绪保持一致，并真正理解你金钱决策背后的行为时，

sentences.en: it just helps you to stick to the plan.
sentences.zh: 这会帮助你坚持计划。

sentences.en: And I fell in love with it so much because one of the questions we would ask is, what is your first memory of money?
sentences.zh: 我非常热爱这个领域，因为我们常问的一个问题是：你关于金钱的第一个记忆是什么？

sentences.en: And for me, professionally and personally, it was such an amazing question because it answered so much from the work that I had
sentences.zh: 对我来说，无论是在职业上还是个人生活中，这都是一个非常棒的问题，因为它解答了我之前在金融素养方面所做的工作，

sentences.en: done in financial literacy to even personally the ups and downs that I've had with money of really understanding the why behind your money decisions,
sentences.zh: 甚至是我个人在金钱上的起起落落，让我真正理解了金钱决策背后的“为什么”，

sentences.en: the skills that you try to implement.
sentences.zh: 以及你试图实施的技能。

sentences.en: A lot of people just have a hard time implementing the skills, even though you know the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 很多人即使知道该怎么做，也很难真正落实这些技能。

sentences.en: So I was in that role for a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我担任那个角色有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And again, I fell in love with the money psychology so much that I went to our leadership and said, you know, I think this is really the future of how people will talk about money.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我太热爱金钱心理学了，所以我找到领导层说，我认为这真的是人们谈论金钱的未来。

sentences.en: I think it's the future of how banks will interact with customers.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是银行与客户互动方式的未来。

sentences.en: So less of the skills.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅仅是技能。

sentences.en: Yes, you have to know how to save, how to inveSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，你必须知道如何储蓄，如何投资。

sentences.en: I can teach you how to do a budget, all those things.
sentences.zh: 我可以教你如何做预算，所有这些事情。

sentences.en: But really understanding that those emotions and the behaviors that will help you to implement
sentences.zh: 但真正理解那些能够帮助你实施技能的情绪和行为，

sentences.en: the skills, having a better relationship with money, I think is the future of how we will talk about it.
sentences.zh: 与金钱建立更好的关系，我认为这是我们未来谈论金钱的方式。

sentences.en: And they said, OK, prove it.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，证明给我看。

sentences.en: And I was given the opportunity to start this role.
sentences.zh: 于是我有机会开启了这个角色。

sentences.en: And most recently, we created a free financial wellness program called Money Roots, where we teach, again, having a better relationship with money with four different workshops.
sentences.zh: 最近，我们创建了一个名为“金钱根源”的免费财务健康项目，我们通过四个不同的研讨会，再次教导人们如何与金钱建立更好的关系。

sentences.en: And I'm sure we'll get into that more.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们之后会深入探讨这一点。

sentences.en: But that's kind of been my journey.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的旅程。

sentences.en: And that's my current role.
sentences.zh: 这就是我目前的角色。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I love how you've just done so many different things, like, and how it's all just linked back to this, what it sounds like this, like desire to understand people better through
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你做过这么多不同的事情，而且这一切都与这种渴望联系在一起，听起来像是通过金钱作为工具来更好地了解人们，对吧？

sentences.en: how, like, money is a tool for them, right?
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个心理学层面的东西。

sentences.en: And it's, like, a real, like, psychological element of it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为这源于我20多岁时，我在金钱方面表现得很糟糕。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think it stemmed from in my 20s, I was horrible at money.
sentences.zh: 我大学毕业时背负了大约3万美元的学生贷款和信用卡债务。

sentences.en: And I graduated from college with about $30,000 in student loan debt and credit card debt.
sentences.zh: 从毕业开始，我就对更好地理解金钱的技能层面产生了热情，特别是信用卡方面。

sentences.en: And from graduating, really became passionate about just having a better understanding of the skill-based side of money, specifically with credit cards.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，我陷入了赚钱、产生信用卡债务、然后还清债务的仓鼠轮循环中。

sentences.en: But as time continued, I was in this hamster wheel of making money, creating credit card debt, and then paying it off.
sentences.zh: 所以我30多岁时一直这样做。

sentences.en: So I did that through my 30s.
sentences.zh: 直到我财务旅程和职业旅程中接触到金钱心理学这一块，我才真正找到了根源：我为什么这样做？

sentences.en: And it really wasn't until this money psychology piece of my financial journey and professional journey, where I really got to the root of, why do I do this?
sentences.zh: 为什么我在金钱方面会做这些事？

sentences.en: Why do I do the things that I do with money?
sentences.zh: 现在我可以设置护栏，帮助自己取得更大的成功。

sentences.en: And now I can put up guardrails to, you know, help me to be more successful.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是一段旅程，我非常高兴能与大家分享。

sentences.en: So it's definitely been a journey and one that I'm so excited to share with everybody else.
sentences.zh: 关于你刚才提到的那部分，我有一个问题。

sentences.en: I have a question for you about that piece you just mentioned.
sentences.zh: 你大学毕业时背负了债务。

sentences.en: You graduated college, you had this debt.
sentences.zh: 当时，你认为你最大的金钱错误是什么？

sentences.en: At the time, what do you think your biggest money mistake was?
sentences.zh: 我认为我最大的错误，深深植根于我的金钱故事中。

sentences.en: I think my biggest, so mine is deeply rooted in my money story.
sentences.zh: 那时我最大的错误就是没有意识到，特别是对于信用卡债务，我为什么要制造这些债务。

sentences.en: My biggest mistake then is just not realizing, specifically for the credit card debt, why I was creating credit card debt.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这源于大量的情感消费，我们在年轻人身上仍然能看到这一点。

sentences.en: And for me, it was grounded in a lot of emotional spending, which we're seeing in young people still.
sentences.zh: 我们在社交媒体上有错失恐惧症（FOMO）。

sentences.en: We have this fear of missing out in social media.
sentences.zh: 你想跟上别人的步伐。

sentences.en: You want to keep up with other people.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，这是源于我从童年时期从社会和父母那里学到的信念所导致的情感消费。

sentences.en: But for me, it was emotional spending from childhood beliefs that I had learned from society and my parents.
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素造就了那个会消费并制造债务的我。

sentences.en: All of those things created this version of me where I would spend and create debt.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我学到的最大教训，也是我希望当时就知道的，那就是当你需要心理治疗时，没有任何金额的钱能解决你的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: So I think the biggest lesson I've learned that I wish I would have known then is that there is no amount of money that can solve your issues when you need therapy, right?
sentences.zh: 当你需要情感支持时，没有包包，没有假期能解决问题。

sentences.en: When you need emotional support for things, there's no purse, there's no vacation.
sentences.zh: 当你有一些需要额外支持的根本问题时，你必须去解决它。

sentences.en: When you have some root issues that require additional support, you have to address that.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，就像对待金钱或食物一样，我们会用这些东西来分散注意力。

sentences.en: And oftentimes, like with money or food, we will use these things to serve as a distraction.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉自己，摆脱这些干扰，真正解决我们的一些根本问题，这样我们才能在与金钱的关系中表现得更好。

sentences.en: So I would tell myself, you know, let's get rid of the distractions, really address some of our root issues so that we can now show up better with our relationship with money.
sentences.zh: 说到人际关系，我今天真正想和你谈的是我们20多岁时金钱与婚姻等人际关系之间的交集。

sentences.en: Speaking of relationships, what we really what I really want to talk to you about today is the intersection between money and relationships in our 20s around marriage.
sentences.zh: 是的，但也仅仅是关于财务兼容性，以及金钱实际上如何在许多方面影响爱情。

sentences.en: Yes, but also just around financial compatibility and how money actually impacts love in many, many ways.
sentences.zh: 让我们从这个问题开始。

sentences.zh: 好的，我喜欢这个问题。

sentences.en: OK, so I love this question.
sentences.zh: 我们在“金钱根源”中教授的课程之一，叫做“爱情与金钱”，我们深入探讨了你刚才提到的内容。

sentences.en: One of the classes that we teach in Money Roots, it's it's really it's called love and money, where we go deep into the very thing you just said.
sentences.zh: 我们深入探讨了你和你的浪漫伴侣。

sentences.en: We go deep into for you and your romantic partner.
sentences.zh: 你和你的伴侣有什么样的信念？

sentences.en: What are the beliefs that you have and your partner has?
sentences.zh: 你从家庭和社会中学到了关于金钱的什么？

sentences.en: What are the things that you learned about money from your family and from society?
sentences.zh: 这些是如何在你们的关系中体现出来的？

sentences.en: And then how does this show up in your relationship?
sentences.zh: 所以大多数人并不具备兼容性。

sentences.en: So most people don't have compatibility.
sentences.zh: 无论出于什么原因，异性相吸。

sentences.en: You will have, you know, for whatever reason, opposites attract.
sentences.zh: 你可能会有挥霍者和储蓄者，一个照顾者和一个逃避者。

sentences.en: You may have the spender and the saver, a nurturer and somebody who's an avoider.
sentences.zh: 我们都有这些金钱人格。

sentences.en: We all have these money personalities.
sentences.zh: 所以第一，了解你的性格是什么很重要。

sentences.en: So one, it's important to know kind of what your personality is.
sentences.zh: 但我希望每个人都能避免对自己的金钱人格感到羞耻。

sentences.en: But I want everyone to avoid shame around whatever your money personality is.
sentences.zh: 所以我坦诚地说，对于我和我的伴侣，我们从大学毕业就在一起了，他更像是一个储蓄者。

sentences.en: So I'll be honest and say for me and my partner, who I've been with since I graduated from college, we he is more of a more of a saver.
sentences.zh: 我更像是一个挥霍者。

sentences.en: I'm more of a spender.
sentences.zh: 我认为在我20多岁的时候，我因为是一个挥霍者而感到非常羞耻，我想要像他一样节俭。

sentences.en: And I think throughout my 20s, I had so much shame around being a spender and I wanted to be frugal like him.
sentences.zh: 但那不是真实的我。

sentences.en: But that's not who I am.
sentences.zh: 我就是一个挥霍者。

sentences.en: I'm a spender.
sentences.zh: 我就是一个挥霍者。

sentences.en: I'm a spender.
sentences.zh: 直到我通过金钱故事达到了一种理解的境界，真正与我的金钱价值观保持一致。

sentences.en: So it wasn't until I got to a place of understanding through your money story, through really getting very aligned with your money values.
sentences.zh: 这就是兼容性发挥作用的地方，因为你们可以是截然不同的。

sentences.en: That's where having compatibility can come into play because you can be opposites.
sentences.zh: 但当你理解了伴侣的金钱故事，理解了伴侣的价值观，

sentences.en: But when you understand your partner's money story, you understand your partner's values.
sentences.zh: 它会为差异创造同理心。

sentences.en: It creates empathy for the differences.
sentences.zh: 所以这不再是关于“你很节俭、吝啬，而我是一个挥霍者，你在所有事情上都超支了”。

sentences.en: So it's less about you're frugal and cheap and I'm a spender and, you know, you're overspending on everything.
sentences.zh: 这种碰撞变成了“哦，我理解她为什么那样”。

sentences.en: The bumping of heads to more of, oh, I understand why she is that way.
sentences.zh: “我理解他为什么那样”。

sentences.en: I understand why he is that way.
sentences.zh: 现在我们能够作为一对情侣走到一起，创造兼容性。

sentences.en: And now we're able to come together as a couple and create compatibility.
sentences.zh: 现在我们可以不再羞耻，而是带着同理心走到一起，说：知道你是这样的人，我是这样的人。

sentences.en: Now we can come together without shame, with empathy to say, knowing that you're this person, I'm this person.
sentences.zh: 我们如何共同前进，围绕金钱创造我们自己的价值观体系？

sentences.en: How do we move forward together to create our own value system around money?
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我们“金钱根源”课程中教授的内容，即“爱情与金钱”。

sentences.en: And that's actually something that we teach in our Money Roots class, the love and money.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上会带你了解那种人格是什么，你的价值观是什么，然后我们如何共同前进，创造一些东西？

sentences.en: We actually take you through understanding what that personality is, what your values are, and then how do we move forward to create something together?
sentences.zh: 当你谈论你的伴侣时，我想，哦，那是一个熟悉的故事。

sentences.en: When you were talking about your partner, I was like, oh, that's a familiar story.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Me and my partner are the same.
sentences.zh: 我和我的伴侣也是一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's always been that way for me.
sentences.zh: 没错，对我来说一直都是这样。

sentences.en: Like money was, again, it's just such an emotional thing.
sentences.zh: 就像金钱一样，它本身就是一件非常感性的事情。

sentences.en: And so, of course, it's going to be like reflected and show up in your relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以，它自然会反映并体现在你们的关系中。

sentences.en: And of course, there's going to be times when, like, what is it?
sentences.zh: 当然，总会有一些时候，怎么说呢？

sentences.en: Like money is the thing that couples argue about the moSt.
sentences.zh: 金钱往往是伴侣之间争吵最多的事情。

sentences.en: What I'm hearing you say is like you don't necessarily have to change all that much.
sentences.zh: 我听你的意思是，你们并不一定非要做出太大的改变。

sentences.en: You just have to understand and find the middle ground of, like, what are we responsible for in this relationship?
sentences.zh: 你们只需要去理解并找到一个中间地带，比如，在这段关系中我们各自承担什么责任？

sentences.en: Is that what you're kind of saying?
sentences.zh: 你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, no, I think, yeah, definitely finding the middle ground and guardrails.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，我认为，是的，绝对要找到中间地带和护栏。

sentences.en: So for me, knowing that I am a spender, I have to deeply attach my spending to my values.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，既然知道自己是个花钱大手大脚的人，我就必须把消费与我的价值观深度挂钩。

sentences.en: So I'm a huge proponent of values-based spending.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常推崇基于价值观的消费。

sentences.en: And what that means is I know my top values are really beautiful things, authenticity, generational wealth, and really my spirituality.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我知道我最重要的价值观是那些美好的事物，比如真实性、代际财富，以及我的精神追求。

sentences.en: So when I anchor, and that's a part of money wellness and money well-being, when you're able to anchor your spending, saving, and giving to your values,
sentences.zh: 所以，当我锚定这些——这也是金钱健康和金钱幸福的一部分——当你能够将你的消费、储蓄和给予与你的价值观挂钩时，

sentences.en: you get a higher return on what I like to say, or higher return on joy.
sentences.zh: 你会获得我所说的更高的回报，或者说更高的快乐回报。

sentences.en: So for me, I know that if a spending, if I'm spending and it doesn't attach to those values, pause.
sentences.zh: 所以对我而言，我知道如果我正在消费，而它与这些价值观不符，那就暂停。

sentences.en: Let's pause and give it 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 让我们暂停一下，给它48小时的冷静期。

sentences.en: You know, is that black pair of pants beautiful enough?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那条黑裤子真的美到非买不可吗？

sentences.en: Does it meet the requirement of my value of really beautiful things?
sentences.zh: 它符合我对“美好事物”的价值观要求吗？

sentences.en: Does it meet my requirement for generational wealth?
sentences.zh: 它符合我对“代际财富”的要求吗？

sentences.en: And that has stopped me in my tracks, I'll be honest, that has stopped me in my tracks with buying things, because I'll give myself that pause of, does this meet my values?
sentences.zh: 说实话，这确实让我停下了脚步，它阻止了我冲动购物，因为我会给自己一个暂停的机会，问问自己：这符合我的价值观吗？

sentences.en: And once you start spending from a place of, this has to meet my values, it increases your well-being with money.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始从“这必须符合我的价值观”的角度去消费，你对金钱的幸福感就会提升。

sentences.en: And then on the other side, for my partner, who is more frugal, now we're looking at it like money is a tool for enjoyment.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，对于我那比较节俭的伴侣来说，我们现在把钱看作是一种享受的工具。

sentences.en: So we got to have a splurge account.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得有一个“挥霍账户”。

sentences.en: We have a splurge account.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有一个挥霍账户。

sentences.en: So it forces him to now say, yes, we're going to save, but we're also going to enjoy the money.
sentences.zh: 这迫使他现在意识到，是的，我们要存钱，但我们也要享受金钱。

sentences.en: We've set money aside to where if I want to, you know, spend $100 on cookies, because that's my latest obsession,
sentences.zh: 我们预留了一笔钱，如果我想花100美元买饼干——因为这是我最近的痴迷，

sentences.en: and he wants to spend $100 on Legos, because that's his latest obsession, that's okay, because we both have that wiggle room within our budget to do so.
sentences.zh: 而他想花100美元买乐高——因为这是他最近的痴迷，那也没关系，因为我们的预算里都有这样的余地。

sentences.en: So again, it's creating those structures within your relationship to make that happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，再次强调，要在你们的关系中建立这些结构来实现这一点。

sentences.en: And it's also knowing how to have the conversation.
sentences.zh: 而且还要知道如何进行沟通。

sentences.en: I think that's a big piece that people are missing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是人们缺失的重要一环。

sentences.en: Which I feel like we can get into in a second.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们稍后可以深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: I want to ask another question on this, though, before we do, which is, how do you deal with inequality in earnings when you're in a long-term relationship,
sentences.zh: 不过在此之前，我想再问一个问题：当你处于长期关系中，或者仅仅是20多岁及以后的恋爱关系中，该如何处理收入不平等的问题？

sentences.en: or you're in just a relationship in your 20s and beyond?
sentences.zh: 或者你只是处于20多岁及以后的恋爱关系中？

sentences.en: What happens when one partner makes significantly more money or significantly less money?
sentences.zh: 当一方赚的钱明显多于或少于另一方时会发生什么？

sentences.en: How do we kind of handle that conversation?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何处理这种对话？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think we have to have transparency.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为我们必须保持透明。

sentences.en: I've talked to people where they'll do a split based off of percentages, and that's how much you put in.
sentences.zh: 我和一些人聊过，他们会按比例分摊开支，这就是你投入的金额。

sentences.en: And some people wanted to make it 50-50 because it makes them feel like they're showing up, and it may make you feel powerful.
sentences.zh: 有些人想实行五五分账，因为这让他们觉得自己在承担责任，也可能让你感觉更有力量。

sentences.en: Again, we've got to understand the story behind that and what is preference for you as an individual.
sentences.zh: 同样，我们必须理解这背后的故事，以及作为个人你更倾向于哪种方式。

sentences.en: So having the transparency, one of, I love to say, money date nights.
sentences.zh: 所以保持透明，我喜欢称之为“金钱约会之夜”。

sentences.en: So I'm a big fan of let's schedule money date nights where we can meet once per week, at minimum once per month,
sentences.zh: 我非常推崇安排金钱约会之夜，我们可以每周或至少每月见一次面，

sentences.en: to talk about these things and create these guidelines and go into it having topics of, are we going to have joint accounts or split accounts?
sentences.zh: 来讨论这些事情，制定准则，并带着话题去沟通，比如：我们要开设联名账户还是分开账户？

sentences.en: Are we going to, how are we going to pay the bills?
sentences.zh: 我们要如何支付账单？

sentences.en: How are we going to be compatible with our values and our beliefs?
sentences.zh: 我们要如何在价值观和信仰上保持一致？

sentences.en: So I think the first step is to just have these conversations and setting time aside to do so.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为第一步就是进行这些对话，并为此预留时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, and also just being incredibly realistic about like, if this person has a certain lifestyle,
sentences.zh: 是的，而且要非常现实地考虑，如果对方有某种生活方式，

sentences.en: could you keep up?
sentences.zh: 你能跟得上吗？

sentences.en: Like, can you keep up with what they want to do and what they want to spend with still doing the 50-50 thing or with you wanting to pay your fair share?
sentences.zh: 比如，你能在坚持五五分账或者你想支付自己那份开支的情况下，跟上他们想做的事和想花的钱吗？

sentences.en: Like, I do feel like I have a couple of friends who are in relationships like this.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得我有几个朋友正处于这样的关系中。

sentences.en: Specifically, I'm thinking about one friend who she makes a lot more than her partner.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我想到一个朋友，她赚的比她伴侣多得多。

sentences.en: And he was always like adamant, like, no, we're going to split everything 50-50.
sentences.zh: 而他总是很坚持，说：“不，我们要一切五五分。”

sentences.en: And it was like, well, then we can't do the things that I actually want to do in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，我们无法去做我真正想在恋爱中做的事情。

sentences.en: So it was like this real, it actually got very like complex with them.
sentences.zh: 所以这变得非常复杂。

sentences.en: It was like ideas of masculinity and like power and equality, but then also like enjoyment and experiences and like what matters more to their relationship,
sentences.zh: 这涉及到了关于男子气概、权力和平等的观念，但也涉及到了享受、体验以及对他们的关系来说什么更重要，

sentences.en: like that they can continue to play the role that they think they should play in a relationship or they can have fun with each other with the cards they're dealt.
sentences.zh: 是他们能继续扮演他们认为在关系中应该扮演的角色，还是他们能利用现有的条件一起玩得开心。

sentences.en: So like it does get very, very complex.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实变得非常、非常复杂。

sentences.en: And I just want to call out everything you just said has nothing to do with money.
sentences.zh: 我只想指出，你刚才说的所有这些都与金钱无关。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It has nothing to do with money.
sentences.zh: 这与金钱毫无关系。

sentences.en: You talked about, no, you talked about gender roles and enjoyment and how do we want to have experiences together.
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是性别角色、享受以及我们想要如何共同体验生活。

sentences.en: It has nothing to do with money.
sentences.zh: 这与金钱无关。

sentences.en: That's a completely separate conversation.
sentences.zh: 那是完全不同的对话。

sentences.en: So the problem is we don't have those conversations.
sentences.zh: 所以问题在于我们没有进行那些对话。

sentences.en: And then it turns into a blow up about money.
sentences.zh: 然后它就演变成了关于金钱的爆发性争吵。

sentences.en: So it's so important when we think of the money date night and how do we have productive conversations with your partner to say,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们想到金钱约会之夜，以及如何与伴侣进行富有成效的对话时，非常重要的一点是说：

sentences.en: my values are experiences and I do want to travel the world.
sentences.zh: 我的价值观是体验，我确实想环游世界。

sentences.en: And so as a partnership, we should allocate our money in this way to do these things.
sentences.zh: 所以作为伴侣，我们应该这样分配我们的钱来做这些事情。

sentences.en: But again, it's realizing that those conversations need to take place.
sentences.zh: 但同样，要意识到这些对话是必须进行的。

sentences.en: And oftentimes people just avoid it and you're ending up in an argument.
sentences.zh: 而人们往往只是回避它，最终导致争吵。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Again, I'm going to pull back that statistic that we said at the start.
sentences.zh: 我还是要引用我们在开头提到的那个统计数据。

sentences.en: It's like the biggest source of conflict in relationships is money.
sentences.zh: 金钱是恋爱关系中最大的冲突来源。

sentences.en: So it's like when you're in your 20s and you're in your relationship, it's like this is everybody focuses on like, oh, let's talk about our attachment styles
sentences.zh: 所以当你20多岁处于恋爱关系中时，每个人都关注于“哦，让我们谈谈我们的依恋类型”，

sentences.en: and let's talk about our future.
sentences.zh: “让我们谈谈我们的未来”。

sentences.en: Like, do we want kids?
sentences.zh: “我们要不要孩子？”

sentences.en: Like, no, you need to have serious conversations about money early on.
sentences.zh: 不，你需要尽早进行关于金钱的严肃对话。

sentences.en: Like, it's actually deeply important.
sentences.zh: 这实际上非常重要。

sentences.en: You do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, the money, the what I love about the work we're doing here at Ally and just this whole movement that you're going to see within.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喜欢我们在Ally所做的工作，以及你将看到的整个运动，

sentences.en: And I hope to see more within money psychology and money wellness is looking at money as a part of your well-being.
sentences.zh: 我希望在金钱心理学和金钱健康方面看到更多，那就是把金钱视为你幸福感的一部分。

sentences.en: So when you think of your social well-being, so your friendships, when you think of your community, where do you live and how do you support it?
sentences.zh: 当你想到你的社会幸福感时，比如你的友谊，当你想到你的社区，你住在哪里以及你如何支持它？

sentences.en: Your career, you think of your fitness and your health.
sentences.zh: 你的职业，你想到你的健身和健康。

sentences.en: Those are all areas of well-being.
sentences.zh: 这些都是幸福感的领域。

sentences.en: And when money is off, it impacts all of that.
sentences.zh: 而当金钱出了问题，它会影响所有这些方面。

sentences.en: When you are not satisfied with your money, we're seeing through our own data that people are up at night.
sentences.zh: 当我们对金钱不满意时，我们从自己的数据中看到，人们彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: They can't sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 他们晚上睡不着觉。

sentences.en: It's impacting their romantic partnerships.
sentences.zh: 这影响了他们的浪漫关系。

sentences.en: So it's so important that even starting in your 20s, you know, not to let money be this static thing, but it is a part of your well-being and to give it its full attention in your
sentences.zh: 所以即使从20多岁开始，不要让金钱成为一个静态的东西，它确实是你幸福感的一部分，并在你的关系中给予它充分的关注，这非常重要。

sentences.en: relationship.
sentences.zh: 关系。

sentences.en: It's so important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to take a short break here, but when we return, we're going to talk about prenups.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们要在这里休息一下，但回来后，我们将讨论婚前协议。

sentences.en: I'm going to talk about-
sentences.zh: 我要谈谈——

sentences.en: Okay, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: We're going to talk about weddings.
sentences.zh: 我们要谈谈婚礼。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续关注我们。

sentences.en: Something that I am so fascinated by is prenups.
sentences.zh: 我非常着迷的一件事是婚前协议。

sentences.en: Why people get them, what they really mean.
sentences.zh: 为什么人们要签它，它们到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: I genuinely, I'm going to be completely transparent.
sentences.zh: 我真心实意地，我要完全透明地说。

sentences.en: I have no idea what a prenup is.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道什么是婚前协议。

sentences.en: Can you kind of give us a little bit of an explanation?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们解释一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So essentially, it's a legal document that outlines your finances and your assets.
sentences.zh: 本质上，它是一份概述你们财务和资产的法律文件。

sentences.en: What happens to it should the marriage end?
sentences.zh: 如果婚姻结束了会怎样？

sentences.en: So we're no longer want to be together.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不再想在一起了。

sentences.en: What do we do with the house?
sentences.zh: 房子怎么办？

sentences.en: What do we do with that bank account?
sentences.zh: 那个银行账户怎么办？

sentences.en: All of those things helps you to think about this before you get to a place of divorce.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都能帮助你在走到离婚那一步之前考虑清楚。

sentences.en: So I look at it as almost insurance for your love.
sentences.zh: 所以我把它看作是你爱情的保险。

sentences.en: So I really want people to shift their perspective about prenups.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的希望人们改变对婚前协议的看法。

sentences.en: And we're finding that in some of our data that it's becoming less of a taboo topic and more of a way for couples to be transparent.
sentences.zh: 我们从一些数据中发现，它正变得不再那么忌讳，更多地成为伴侣之间保持透明的一种方式。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I'm going to ask some really naive questions.
sentences.zh: 我要问一些非常幼稚的问题。

sentences.en: Do you only need a prenup if you have existing wealth?
sentences.zh: 只有在你拥有现有财富的情况下才需要婚前协议吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And here's why.
sentences.zh: 原因如下。

sentences.en: Here's why.
sentences.zh: 原因如下。

sentences.en: So for everybody out there in your 20s, my question is, do you think you will have the same amount of wealth in your 40s and 50s that you have in your 20s?
sentences.zh: 所以对于所有20多岁的人，我的问题是，你认为你在40多岁和50多岁时拥有的财富会和你20多岁时一样多吗？

sentences.en: I'm hoping for most people, the answer is going to be no.
sentences.zh: 我希望对大多数人来说，答案是否定的。

sentences.en: So the person that you are in your 20s, the amount of assets that you have in your 20s compared to when you're older, it changes.
